name: 37218 · Nashville, TN
findings: ZIP 37218 (Nashville) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37218 (Nashville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 37218 (Nashville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
